description: Compute the Drake equation N (detectable civilisations in the Milky Way) from your factors or a preset, and the probability that we are alone once uncertainty is spread honestly (Sandberg, Drexler & Ord 2018). Use it for 'are we alone' and Fermi-paradox questions; it says nothing about UFO sightings (for a light in the sky use what_did_i_see). Unset factors take the preset or default values. Local calculation, no network call.

R.description: Star formation rate in the Milky Way, stars per year (0-1000).

fc.description: Fraction of those that emit detectable signals (0-1).

fi.description: Fraction of those where intelligence appears (0-1).

fl.description: Fraction of those where life appears (0-1).

ne.description: Habitable planets per star with planets (0-100).

preset.description: Set of factors: pessimiste, gb-bas, gb-haut (Green Bank 1961 low/high), optimiste.

name: drake_equation

outputSchema.description: Returns N_civilisations_detectable_in_milky_way, inputs, presets, reading, uncertainty_matters.

title: Drake equation and Fermi paradox
